ctx.x: All those guys used to come in to hear Art Tatum. He had some people like Canada Lee. following. Paul Robeson...'cause Paul was, you know, he felt dejected. He used to come in...but those were very rare moments and they were moments that, when the final pages are written, it definitely will be part of the history. It will have to be.

I don't see how they can write...you know, I'm amazed at these guys writing...they don't even include all the names of the people who were there. I remember more names than they do. Zero Mostel, Jackie Gifford, Imogene Coca...they don't have them together with, you know what I mean. 'Cause Barney...
